full_judgment: 3. Defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations of the plaint and contended inter alia that the suit as framed is not maintainable in law as complicated questions of title were involved in it. It was also alleged that the plaintiff had no cause of action and he filed the present suit with false and frivolous allegations. The further case of the contesting defendant is that the suit land belonged to Basirul Haque and the R.S. Khatian was rightly prepared in his name. It was further alleged that the suit land was mortgaged by Basirul Haque with Sarat Chowdhury and his four brothers for the period 1925-38 and the mortgages owned and possessed the same in their own right and the defendants as heirs of the mortgages have possessed the same for a long period. It was further alleged that after a long lapse of time, the defendant took settlement of 641/2 decimals of land from Shamsul Huda Chowdhury, son of Basirul Huq by patta dated 30.12.45 and since then he has been owning and possessing the same. It was further contended that thereafter he shifted his home-stead to the contiguous northern bank of the tank in question in 1393 B.S. as adjunct to his homestead and he owns and possesses the same by planting various tress and growing seasonal vegetables therein. It was also contended that the plaintiff has no title and possession in the suit land and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
